thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 09/17/2018: XNET, AMZN, VEON, QTM

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 09/17/2018: XNET, AMZN, VEON, QTM
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.1%
AAPL: -0.9%
IBM: -0.1%
CSCO: flat
GOOG: flat
Technology shares were lower in pre-market trading on Monday.
Expected movers:
- Xunlei ( XNET ) signed a strategic partnership with Newland Hi-Tech Group to research and develop new products and services
- Amazon ( AMZN ) launched "Amazon Storefronts"
- Veon ( VEON ) terminated the sale of its tower business in Pakistan to Tanzanite Tower
Other news:
- Quantum Corp.'s ( QTM ) special committee completed its internal investigation into its financial statements
